cards.name: Balduvian Dead
cards.note: '{2}{R}, Exile a creature card from your graveyard: create a 3/1 Graveborn token with haste. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step' is not supported: no effect names the token it just created for a delayed end-step sacrifice (the token would stay for good, which is more than printed), so the ability is left off and the card is a 2/3 creature

cards.name: Benthic Explorers
cards.note: '{T}, Untap a tapped land an opponent controls: Add one mana of any type that land could produce' is not supported: no cost untaps another player's tapped land and no mana effect reads what a chosen land could produce, so the ability is left off (a bare {T} for any color would be free mana the card does not print) and the card is a 2/4 creature

cards.name: Bestial Fury
cards.note: attaches to target creature, draws a card at the beginning of the next turn's upkeep when it enters, and grants enchanted creature a trigger that gives it +4/+0 and trample until end of turn whenever it becomes blocked; the becomes-blocked trigger is granted to the enchanted creature instead of being the Aura's own, so the creature's controller controls it and it is lost when the creature loses its abilities

cards.name: Chaos Harlequin
cards.note: '{R}: Exile the top card of your library. If that card is a land card, this creature gets -4/-0 until end of turn. Otherwise, this creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn' is not supported: no effect exiles the top card and then branches on whether it was a land card, and a bare +2/+0 for {R} would never give the -4/-0, so the ability is left off and the card is a 2/4 creature

cards.name: Contagion
cards.note: may be cast by paying 1 life and exiling a black card from your hand rather than paying its mana cost, and puts two -2/-1 counters on target creature; distributing those two counters across two target creatures is not supported

cards.name: Death Spark
cards.note: deals 1 damage to any target; at the beginning of your upkeep, if it is in your graveyard with exactly one card above it and that card is a creature card, you may pay {1} to return it to your hand; a creature card directly above it with other cards on top of that is not recognised, so the return happens less often than printed

cards.name: Fyndhorn Druid
cards.note: the dies trigger 'if it was blocked this turn, you gain 4 life' is not supported: nothing reads that this creature was blocked this turn, and gaining the 4 life on every death would be more than printed, so the trigger is left off and the card is a 2/2

cards.name: Gargantuan Gorilla
cards.note: granting trample until end of turn if you sacrifice a snow Forest to the upkeep ability is not supported; at the beginning of your upkeep you may sacrifice a Forest, or else sacrifice this creature and it deals 7 damage to you, and {T} exchanges damage equal to power with another target creature

cards.name: Gift of the Woods
cards.note: the trigger is granted to the enchanted creature instead of being the Aura's own, so the life is gained by the enchanted creature's controller (the Aura's controller until the creature changes control), a creature that loses its abilities loses the trigger, and the Aura may enchant only a creature you control

cards.name: Gorilla Berserkers
cards.note: requiring three or more creatures to block is not supported; has trample and rampage 2 (+2/+2 until end of turn for each blocker beyond the first)

cards.name: Krovikan Horror
cards.note: at the beginning of the end step, if it is in your graveyard with exactly one card above it and that card is a creature card, you may return it to your hand, and {1}, sacrifice a creature deals 1 damage to any target; a creature card directly above it with other cards on top of that is not recognised, so the return happens less often than printed

cards.name: Lodestone Bauble
cards.note: Targeting up to four basic land cards from a player's graveyard and putting them on top in any order is not said (one card moves), and "that player draws" cannot name anyone but the controller, so only the controller's own graveyard is offered; in play, Lodestone Bauble puts one target basic land card from your graveyard on top of your library and you draw a card at the beginning of the next turn's upkeep.

cards.name: Misinformation
cards.note: Putting up to three target cards from an opponent's graveyard on top of their library in any order requires multi-target graveyard-to-top ordering in Effect::GraveyardToTop; in play, Misinformation puts the first targeted card from an opponent's graveyard on top of its owner's library.

cards.name: Phyrexian Devourer
cards.note: Exiling the top card of your library as an activation cost and putting X +1/+1 counters on Phyrexian Devourer equal to the exiled card's mana value has no CostPart or Amount representation; in play, Phyrexian Devourer sacrifices itself when its power is 7 or greater.

cards.name: Primitive Justice
cards.note: Paying {1}{R} and/or {1}{G} any number of times as an additional cost to destroy an additional target artifact per payment and gain 1 life per {1}{G} paid has no DSL representation; in play, Primitive Justice destroys one target artifact.

cards.name: Reinforcements
cards.note: Putting up to three target creature cards from your graveyard on top of your library in any order requires multi-target graveyard-to-top ordering in Effect::GraveyardToTop; in play, Reinforcements puts the first targeted creature card from your graveyard on top of your library.

cards.name: Royal Herbalist
cards.note: Exiling the top card of your library as part of an activation cost has no CostPart, and the ability without that cost would gain life for free; Royal Herbalist is a 1/1 with no ability.

cards.name: Scars of the Veteran
cards.note: Prevents the next 7 damage that would be dealt to any target this turn (including via the white-card exile pitch cost), without putting +0/+1 counters on a creature at the beginning of the next end step for each 1 damage prevented this way.

cards.name: Seasoned Tactician
cards.note: The {3}, exile-the-top-four-cards-of-your-library ability is not played: there is no cost for exiling the top cards of a library, and the shield without it would cost {3} alone; Seasoned Tactician enters as a 1/3 with no abilities.

cards.name: Soldevi Heretic
cards.note: The {W}, {T} ability is not played: its opponent can be targeted in the second target group, but no effect-player reference reads that independently bound second targeted player for the optional draw; the shield without the draw would play stronger than printed. Only the 2/2 body is played.

cards.name: Soldevi Sage
cards.note: "Draw three cards, then discard one of them" cannot name the discard among the cards drawn this way: the only discard effect takes any card from the hand, which is more than printed; Soldevi Sage enters as a 1/1 with no abilities.

cards.name: Soldevi Sentry
cards.note: The {1} ability is not played: its drawback "When it regenerates this way, that player may draw a card" cannot be said (nothing triggers when a regeneration shield is used), and regeneration without it would play stronger than printed; Soldevi Sentry enters as a 1/1 with no abilities.

cards.name: Spiny Starfish
cards.note: The {U} regeneration ability is implemented; the end-step trigger that creates 0/1 blue Starfish tokens for each time this creature regenerated this turn is not implemented.

cards.name: Storm Elemental
cards.note: Neither {U}, exile-the-top-card-of-your-library ability is played: there is no cost for exiling the top card of a library, and no condition reads whether the exiled card is a snow land; Storm Elemental enters as a 3/4 flyer with no activated abilities.

cards.name: Stromgald Spy
cards.note: The defending player's hand is revealed once when this creature attacks and isn't blocked, not for as long as this creature remains on the battlefield; the "may" and "this creature assigns no combat damage this turn" are played.

cards.name: Taste of Paradise
cards.note: The {1}{G} additional cost may be paid at most once rather than any number of times; paying it gains 6 life instead of 3.

cards.name: Tornado
cards.note: Cumulative upkeep {G} and the first activation of the {2}{G} ability (no velocity counter yet, so no life to pay) are played, once each turn; later activations cost 3 life for each velocity counter, and the cost has no per-counter life payment, so with a velocity counter on Tornado the ability is not offered.

cards.name: Undergrowth
cards.note: Only the plain cast is played: all combat damage that would be dealt this turn is prevented. The optional {2}{R} additional cost, which exempts the combat damage of red creatures, is not offered because no effect prevents all combat damage except by sources matching a filter.

cards.name: Varchild's War-Riders
cards.note: The cumulative upkeep always pays (an age counter, then each opponent creates a 1/1 red Survivor token per age counter), so the controller cannot decline it and sacrifice the creature, and with several opponents each of them creates the tokens, not one chosen opponent; Trample and rampage 1 work as printed.
